steps.action: Tap the main button of step 1 of "Update the Play store listing" twice, fast.
user_sees: One result; the button shows it is busy
must_not: Two rows of saved data, two charges, two messages sent, or two screens opened

note: Two runs share concurrency group play-edit with the release's Play upload; a third queued run cancels the pending one
